rolesAndResponsibilities: Develop and maintain front-end features using React, next.js, and/or Angular. Translate product and design requirements into clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Implement UI integration with backend services and support API integration using REST or GraphQL. Apply performance optimization techniques to improve load times, rendering efficiency, and overall user experience. Ensure cross-browser compatibility, responsiveness, and accessibility standards are met. Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous improvement of front-end applications. Work with shared component libraries and contribute to scalable UI patterns and reusable modules. Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA, and product stakeholders during development and release cycles.

rolesAndResponsibilities: Develop, enhance, and maintain responsive web applications using React.js and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Implement intuitive UI designs using HTML5, CSS3, and modern layout techniques (Flexbox, CSS Grid). Manage state efficiently with Redux, Context API, or similar libraries. Set up and configure React Router (or similar) for smooth client-side navigation. Integrate and consume RESTful APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is a plus. Build reusable components and optimize application performance for speed and scalability. Collaborate using Git and follow best practices for code reviews, branching, and version control. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve front-end issues efficiently. Work independently or as part of a team to meet project deadlines.
